_comment: Pin for the mod_pagespeed module release whose sidecar files the NuGet
lane takes (pipeline-release-nuget.yml, job sidecar-fetch). The lane reads
this file from main, like the signing script and the release key.
tag: the module release tag (module-v<version>); a real run of v<version>
sha256sums_sha256: sha256 of that release's SHA256SUMS file.
sidecar_pair_sha256: sha256 of that release's sidecar-pair.json.
release_key_fingerprint: the key SHA256SUMS.asc must be signed with; it
must equal the fingerprint pinned in tools/ci/release_checksums_sig.sh and
Update on each cut, after the module release is published and before the
v<version> tag: cut the optimizer release, then the module release, then
record this pin on main, then tag v<version>.
A PLACEHOLDER tag makes the lane refuse loudly.
